To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed class of estimator is a better alternative to the existing estimator for the estimation of the population mean under the present sampling design.
the proposed class of estimator has been found to be superior to the sample mean estimator in terms of mean square error.
the proposed class of estimator is more efficient in terms of MSE than the sample mean estimator in all cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the estimation of population mean under two-occasion successive sampling in presence of occurrence of random non response in either or both of the occasions.
the estimation of population mean in two-occasion rotation sampling in the presence of random non responses on the current occasion.
the estimation of population mean under successive sampling with the occurrence of random non response in one or two of the occasions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed class of estimator is a better alternative to the conventional estimator for estimating population mean in successive (rotation) sample design.
the proposed class of estimator is more efficient and reliable than the sample mean estimator in the sense of mean square error criterion.
the proposed estimators are more efficient than the sample mean estimator in the presence of random non responses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed class of imputation based estimator is found to be more efficient than the sample mean estimator in the sense that the proposed estimators are more robust against random non responses.
the proposed class of estimator is a good choice for estimating population mean in presence of random missing data.
the proposed class of estimator is a good substitute of the sample mean estimator for estimating the population mean on current occasion in successive sampling in presence of non response situations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed estimator can be used in the situations where the sample size on the current occasion is small.
the proposed estimators are more efficient than the sample mean estimator in presence of random missing data.
the proposed class of estimator performs well in the situations of random non response.
